I replied to Tobias in the #inc-tansley-carrier-api thread: the depot was Southgate.

That comes from Pree Sundaram's messages in that channel on 3 Sep 2025, which Tobias can see. While label printing was stalled, Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. By 18:43 Southgate had cleared the backlog and the incident was closed.

I couldn't find an address or city for Southgate anywhere I searched. So I told him that, and suggested he check with Pree (the account manager) or Lev Arkadin, the customer's procurement contact, before the call. No other information was shared.
